subject: Extract df from an under-identified model

messages.author: 2f41c1764121050d
messages.subject: Extract df from an under-identified model
parts:
Is it possible to extract the degrees of freedom from an under-identified model (that has more parameters than known values). That is, I'd like to extract the df even when the df is negative. As a teaching exercise, I'm fitting a formative model and would like to demonstrate that additional constraints are required to make the model identifiable.

The model fit output shows the negative degrees of freedom:

```
> formativeModelFit lavaan 0.6.16 ended normally after 1 iteration Estimator ML Optimization method NLMINB Number of model parameters 5 Used Total Number of observations 44 75 Number of missing patterns 1 Model Test User Model: Test statistic NA Degrees of freedom -5 P-value (Unknown) NA
```

However, when I try to extract the df using the fitMeasures() function, here is what I get:

```
> fitMeasures(formativeModelFit, "df") numeric(0)
```

Here is the output of the fitMeasures() command when not specifying "df":

```
> fitMeasures(formativeModelFit) Error in if (!is.finite(X2) || !is.finite(df) || !is.finite(X2.null) || : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed In addition: Warning messages: 1: In lav_partable_check(lavpartable, categorical = lavoptions$.categorical, : lavaan WARNING: automatically added intercepts are set to zero: [formative] 2: In lav_fit_cfi_lavobject(lavobject = object, fit.measures = fit.measures, : lavaan WARNING: computation of robust CFI failed.
```
